detail.title: CP-UVR-1601E2V-I
features: Supports HDCVI, AHD, TVI, CVBS and IP video input
Supports up to 18 channels of IPC access, including 2 additional IP channels + 16 analog channels, with the option to convert all analog channels to IP
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264, Dual stream video compression
16 Channel two-way talk over coaxial cable allows for seamless communication between the camera, client and recorder
16 Channel IMD+ for analog channels or 18 Channel IMD by camera which allows  the device to trigger accurate alarms for humans and  vehicles
Support 2 SATA HDD up to 16TB Each, 2 USB Ports,                    1 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 RS485

General.IP Camera Input:
Up to 18 channels of IPC access 2 IP channel by default + 16 channels (analog channels are
converted to IP channels) Incoming bandwidth: 64 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 64 Mbps and
outgoing bandwidth: 64 Mbps
General.Two-way Talk:
Coaxial two-way talk: 16 Channel BNC Local and network user two-way talk: Shares the same
audio input with the first channel
General.Encoding Capacity:
Main stream: 1st channel 1080N/720p@(1 fps– 25/30 fps), others 1080N/720p@(1 fps–15
fps); 960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps)
Sub stream: CIF@(1 fps–7 fps)
General.IMD+ by DVR:
16 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and vehicle, Reducing false alarms caused by
leaves, Rain and lighting condition change
General.Hard Disk:
2 SATA ports. Each disk can contain up to 16 TB. this limit varies depending on the environ-
ment temperature
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, Alarm box, HDCVI alarm, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, PIR alarm
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), IPC external alarm output, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Playback: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.Interface Ports: 2 USB (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 2.0 port), 1 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 RS485
General.Protocol:
HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP,
DDNS, SNMP, Alarm Server, InstaOn, Auto Connect, ONVIF (Profile T, Profile S, Profile G), CGI,
SDK
General.Abnormality Alarm:
Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, Low quota space, Network disconnection, IP conflict,
MAC conflict), Video loss, Video tampering, Camera offline
General.Video Display Split:
When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9/16
When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25
